Rashi on Keritot 17a:10:1.hebrew: אמר רבא - לעולם, "ומודה" דקתני — לר"א מודה, ואהך פלוגתא קאי דפליגי בהדא:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:10:1.english: Rava said - Actually, [as for] "and he concedes" that it teaches, he concedes to Rabbi Eliezer, and it refers to this dispute, where they disagree about this.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:10:2.english: In two lapses of awareness [he is] exempt - And [this means that] awareness applies to a half-measure.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:10:3.hebrew: לשתי רשויות - ושתיהן רה"ר, פטור, דרשויות מחלקות. ברייתא דלעיל — מודה ר' גמליאל לר"א דשבתות כגופין דמיין, דמחלקין לכתיבת שתי אותיות מלצרף, אבל בהא פליג עליה, דרשויות לא מחלקות:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:10:3.english: To two domains - And both of them are a public domain, [he is] exempt, for [separate] domains divide [the acts]. [As for] the baraita above — Rabban Gamliel concedes to Rabbi Eliezer that [separate] Shabbatot are like [separate] bodies, in that they divide [acts] with respect to writing two letters from combining; but in this [matter] he disagrees with him, for [separate] domains do not divide [them].

Rashi on Keritot 17a:13:1.hebrew: היינו דקא"ל ומה נדה - דנדה אית בה ידיעת ימים שבינתים, כדמפרש לקמן:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:13:1.english: That is [the reason] that he said to him: "Just as [in the case of] a menstruating woman" - For [in the case of] a menstruating woman, there is awareness [from] the intervening days, as [the Gemara] explains below.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:14:1.hebrew: אלא לרבא דאמר - דגופין בעא מיניה, מאי פשיט ליה מנדה? בנדה מאי חילוק גופין איכא:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:14:1.english: But according to Rava, who says - That he asked him regarding [separate] entities, what did [Rabbi Eliezer] resolve for him from [the case of] a menstruating woman? In [the case of] a menstruating woman, what distinction of [separate] entities is there?

Rashi on Keritot 17a:15:1.hebrew: תני נדות - מה נדות, שאין בהן תוצאות הרבה, הבא על חמש נשים נדות חייב על כל אחת ואחת כו' דגופין נינהו; שבתות, לא כ"ש שהן גופין:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:15:1.english: Teach: Menstruating women - Just as [in the case of] menstruating women, where there are not many derivatives — one who engages in intercourse with five menstruating women is liable for each and every one, etc., because they are [separate] bodies — [in the case of] Shabbatot, is it not all the more so [that he is liable], since they are [like separate] bodies?

Rashi on Keritot 17a:15:2.hebrew: שמואל תני נדה - דס"ל כרב חסדא:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:15:2.english: Shmuel teaches “menstruating woman” - For he holds like Rav Chisda.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:19:1.english: Minor girls in general - [This refers to] many men who engage in intercourse with many minor girls during [their] menstruation.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:1:1.hebrew: והא דתניא חייב בשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות - דאי נמי סבירא לן ימים שבינתים ידיעה הן, הכא ליכא למימר דמהני חילוק שבתות לחלק שלא יצטרפו, דקסבר אין ידיעה לחצי שיעור:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:1:1.english: And that which is taught [that he is] liable, in [a case of] unwittingness [regarding] Shabbat and intentionality [regarding] labors - For even if we hold [that] the intervening days are [considered] awareness, here one cannot say that the division of Shabbatot is effective to separate [them] so that they do not combine, as he holds [that] there is no awareness for a half-measure.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:20:1.hebrew: לא כי האי תנא - דהאי תנא סבר נדה מיבעיא ליה, ושבת פשיטא ליה:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:20:1.english: Not like this tanna - For this tanna holds [that regarding] a menstruating woman, it was uncertain to him [Rabbi Akiva], and [regarding] Shabbat, it was obvious to him.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:21:1.english: Liable for each and every one - If he performed five primary categories of labor in one lapse of awareness.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:24:1.english: With an animal - Many acts of intercourse with one [animal].

Rashi on Keritot 17a:24:2.english: An animal - It is uncertain to him, like [the case of] a menstruating woman.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:26:1.hebrew: ספק אכל חלב - מפרש בגמרא, מר אמר חתיכה אחת ומר אמר שתי חתיכות:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:26:1.english: Uncertainty [whether] one ate [forbidden] fat - It is explained in the Gemara: one [Sage] says [it refers to] one piece, and one [Sage] says [it refers to] two pieces.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:26:2.hebrew: ואפילו אכל - כגון שסבור שומן הוא, ואח"כ נודע לו שהוא אכל חלב, אבל ספק יש בו כזית, ספק אין בו:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:26:2.english: And even [if] he ate - For example, where he thought it was permitted fat, and afterward it became known to him that he ate forbidden fat, but there is uncertainty whether there is an olive's bulk in it, [or] uncertainty whether there is not.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:4:1.hebrew: לא בחדא ולא בחדא - בשגגת מלאכות לא מוקמת לה, דהא אמר לעיל לר' עקיבא לאו כגופין דמיין ומצטרפין. ובשגגת שבת נמי לא, דאי נמי אמרינן ימים שבינתיים הויין ידיעה לחלק, הא שמעינן ליה לר"ג לעיל דאין ידיעה לחצי שיעור, דקתני: בשתי העלמות ר"ג מחייב:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:4:1.english: Neither in this [case] nor in that [case] - You cannot interpret it [as referring] to unawareness of [prohibited] labors, for it was said above [that] according to Rabbi Akiva they are not like [distinct] bodies and they combine. And [you] also [cannot interpret it as referring] to unawareness of Shabbat, for even if we say [that] the intervening days constitute awareness to separate [the acts], behold, we heard above regarding Rabban Gamliel that there is no awareness for a half-measure, as it is taught: In two lapses of awareness, Rabban Gamliel holds [him] liable.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:6:1.hebrew: א"א בשלמא כר"ע ס"ל - דאית ליה לר"ע נמי שבתות כגופין דמיין, והא דקתני "מודה", לר"ע הוא דמודה; היינו דפליגי בהכותב אות אחת בשבת זו ואות אחת בשבת זו, בשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות, דר' גמליאל מחייב כאידך ברייתא, דאין ידיעת ימים שבינתים מועלת לחצי שיעור, ור' עקיבא — היינו חכמים דפטרי — סבר יש ידיעה:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:6:1.english: Granted, if you say he holds in accordance with Rabbi Akiva - For Rabbi Akiva also holds [that] Shabbatot are like [separate] bodies, and that which it teaches, "concedes," [means] it is to Rabbi Akiva that he concedes. This is [why] they disagree regarding one who writes one letter on this Shabbat and one letter on that Shabbat, [acting] unwittingly [as to] Shabbat and intentionally [as to] labors: for Rabban Gamliel obligates [him] as in the other baraita, because the awareness of the intervening days is not effective for a half-measure, whereas Rabbi Akiva — who is [the opinion of] the Sages who exempt [him] — holds there is awareness [for a half-measure].

Rashi on Keritot 17a:7:1.hebrew: אלא אי אמרת כר"א ס"ל - בשגגת מלאכות וזדון שבת, דהאי דקתני "ומודה" לר"א קאמר, על כרחיך מכלל דפליגי במקצת:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:7:1.english: But if you say he holds in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer - in [a case of] unwittingness of labors and intentionality of Shabbat, for this [statement] that it teaches "and [he] concedes," it is speaking to Rabbi Eliezer — perforce, [it follows] by inference that they disagree in part.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:8:1.hebrew: ר"א מחייב - ודאי בשגגת שבת קאמר, ומש"ה קתני דאין ידיעה לחצי שיעור; דאי בשגגת שבת וזדון מלאכות, הא כולי עלמא מודו דלר"א שבתות כגופין דמיין ופטור:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:8:1.english: Rabbi Eliezer deems [him] liable - He is certainly speaking of unwittingness regarding Shabbat, and for that reason it teaches that there is no awareness for a half-measure; for if [it were speaking] of unwittingness regarding Shabbat and intentionality regarding labors [i.e., intentionality regarding Shabbat and unwittingness regarding labors], everyone agrees that according to Rabbi Eliezer, [different] Shabbatot are like [separate] entities and he is exempt.

Rashi on Keritot 17a:9:1.hebrew: אלא באחת על האריג - פליגי ר' גמליאל ור"א, והכי קאמר: מודה ר"ג לר"א בכותב אות אחת כו', זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכה, שהוא פטור, דשבתות כגופין דמיין. ואף על גב דפליג עליה באחת על האריג, דהתם מחייב ר' גמליאל, אע"ג דדמי להאי דכותב חצי שיעור בשבת שני ומשלים לשיעור הראשון, ואורג נמי חצי שיעור על האריג — אפילו הכי מחייב ר"ג. דהכא היינו טעמא, דשבתות כגופין דמיין ולא מצטרפין, דדמי כחורש חצי שיעור וזורע חצי שיעור; אבל באורג, דמעיקרא הוי בהאי בגד אריג שיעור הרבה, חשיב האי חוט שארג זה אגב כל הבגד. ואף על גב דת"ק דר' גמליאל דפליג עליה באין ידיעה לחצי שיעור לאו ר"א הוא, אפילו הכי האי "ומודה" דקתני אדר"א קאי, ואפלוגתא דאחת על האריג; והא דקתני ליה הכא גבי העלמות — איידי דאיירי בכותב לחצאים. ומקשה: הא ר"א נמי חיובי מחייב:
Rashi on Keritot 17a:9:1.english: Rather, with [regard to] one [thread] onto a woven fabric - Rabban Gamliel and Rabbi Eliezer disagree [about that], and this is what [the baraita] is saying: Rabban Gamliel concedes to Rabbi Eliezer in [the case of] one who writes one letter, etc., [with] intentional [violation of] Shabbat and unwitting [commission of] the forbidden labor, that he is exempt, because [different] Shabbats are considered like [separate] bodies. And even though [Rabban Gamliel] disagrees with him regarding [weaving] one [thread] onto a woven fabric — for there Rabban Gamliel deems [him] liable, even though it is similar to this [case] where one writes half the [minimum] measure on the second Shabbat and completes the first measure, and [likewise here] one also weaves half the [minimum] measure onto the woven fabric — even so, Rabban Gamliel deems [him] liable [there]. For here, this is the reason: [different] Shabbats are considered like [separate] bodies and do not combine, so it is similar to one who plows half a measure and sows half a measure. However, in [the case of] weaving, since originally there was already a large measure of woven [fabric] in this garment, this thread that this [person] wove is considered significant by virtue of the entire garment. And even though the Tanna Kamma of Rabban Gamliel, who disagrees with him regarding [the principle that] awareness does not apply to half a measure, is not Rabbi Eliezer, nevertheless this [word] "and he concedes" that [the baraita] teaches refers to Rabbi Eliezer and to the dispute regarding one [thread] onto a woven fabric; and the reason it teaches it here among [cases of] lapses of awareness is because it is dealing with one who writes in halves. [Yet the Gemara objects:] Behold, Rabbi Eliezer also deems [him] liable!

Tosafot on Keritot 17a:11:1.hebrew: ר"ג כתנא קמא - וקשה, דמאי קאמר כת"ק? דלר"ג העלמות אינן מחלקות, שהרי כפשטה לא מצינו למימר, דהא ת"ק קאמר בשתי העלמות פטור:
Tosafot on Keritot 17a:11:1.english: Rabban Gamliel [holds] in accordance with the first tanna - And it is difficult: for what does it mean "in accordance with the first tanna"? For according to Rabban Gamliel, lapses of awareness do not separate [the acts]! For according to its plain meaning we cannot say [so], since the first tanna says [that] in two lapses of awareness he is exempt.

Tosafot on Keritot 17a:24:1.hebrew: אמר לו הבא על בהמה יוכיח שאין גופין מוחלקין - וה"ה דמצי למימר נדה יוכיח, שהרי ר"א מחייב על כל אחת ואחת; אלא שלא שמע מרבותיו נדה, רק בהמה — לכך נקט ליה:
Tosafot on Keritot 17a:24:1.english: He said to him: [The case of] one who copulates with an animal will prove [it], as there are no separate entities - And the same applies that he could have said "[the case of] a menstruating woman will prove [it]," for Rabbi Eliezer holds [one] liable for each and every [act]; rather, [it is] because he had not heard from his teachers [the law of] a menstruating woman, only [that of] an animal — therefore he cited it.

Tosafot on Keritot 17a:26:1.hebrew: ספק אכל כו' - ומיירי בשעה שאכל היה סבור שהוא שומן, דאי יודע שהוא ספק חלב, היכי מייתי קרבן? הא לא שב מידיעתו:
Tosafot on Keritot 17a:26:1.english: "If there is uncertainty whether one ate, etc." - And [the Mishnah] is speaking [of a case where] at the time he ate [it], he thought that it was [permitted] fat; for if he knew that it was possibly forbidden fat, how could he bring an offering? Behold, he has not turned back from his knowledge [i.e., he did not act out of unawareness]!
